description: Full name stored as free-text with 30 distinct non-null values (100% unique, no missing). Contains multicultural naming patterns including Malay patronymics (Bin/Binte) and Indian patronymics (s/o, d/o). Two values deviate from the dominant Title Case convention: one in all-lowercase and one in all-uppercase.
recommended_actions: [STANDARDIZE] Standardize deterministic case deviations to Title Case: 'lim wei jie' → 'Lim Wei Jie', 'WANG SHI JIE' → 'Wang Shi Jie'.
